# Ex 50 · Your First Website

不启动真实服务器：用函数模拟「收到请求 → 返回响应」，全程可离线跑。

## 目标
- 理解请求/响应的最小模型
- 写一个返回 HTML 字符串的 handler

## 自检
- [ ] 打印出 status 与 body
- [ ] 改 HTML 文案再跑一次

starterFiles.ex50.py:
def handle_request(method: str, path: str) -> tuple[int, str, str]: """Return (status, content_type, body).""" print(f"[REQ] {method} {path}") if method == "GET" and path == "/": body = "

Hello LPTHW

Offline fake web server.

" return 200, "text/html", body return 404, "text/plain", "Not Found" def send_response(status: int, content_type: str, body: str) -> None: print(f"[RES] {status}") print(f"Content-Type: {content_type}") print() print(body) status, ctype, body = handle_request("GET", "/") send_response(status, ctype, body) print("---") status, ctype, body = handle_request("GET", "/missing") send_response(status, ctype, body)
